messages.author: 6d32ef5edf218bc8
messages.subject: Error when creating species richness shapefile
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am trying to create a species richness plot with the detectionMaps command. The location of my cameras is projected (in UTM 48N). However when I try to include the correct projection (see below) it gives me the following error: 

Error in rgdal::writeOGR(obj = spdf, dsn = shapefileDirectory, layer = layer.tmp,  : 
  Can't convert columns of class: array; column names: n_species

I suppose I am doing something wrong because if I exclude the creation of a shapefile it runs but creates a data frame and not a spatial points data frame.


spRichness <- detectionMaps(CTtable = ct,
                            recordTable = spc,
                            Xcol = "UTM_E",# x col in the ct table
                            Ycol = "UTM_N",# y col in the ct table
                            stationCol = "Station",
                            speciesCol = "Species",
                            richnessPlot = TRUE, 
                            speciesPlots = FALSE, 
                            addLegend = TRUE,
                            printLabels = TRUE,
                            smallPoints = 2,
                            writeShapefile = TRUE,
                            shapefileName = "Speciess Richness Plot",
                            shapefileProjection = "+init=epsg:32647",
                            shapefileDirectory = sppPlots                          
                            
                            
                            
)

Any help would be much appreciated!

Dominik

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error when creating species richness shapefile
parts:
Hi Dominik,
give it a try with
shapefileProjection = "+proj=utm +zone=48 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"

If that doesn't help please share
str(spRichness)

after running the function with
writeShapefile = FALSE

I can't quite make sense of the error message. For some reason the data are not in the correct format for saving the shapefile, but I don't know how that would happen.
Thank you,
Jürgen
